sentences.en: My sister is clumsy, which is a disadvantage to her.
sentences.zh: 我妹妹很笨拙，这对她不利。

sentences.en: I am still clumsy catching batons thrown high up.
sentences.zh: 我仍然接不住高抛过来的接力棒，真是笨手笨脚。

sentences.en: Has no-one ever told you how clumsy you are?
sentences.zh: 没人告诉过你你有多笨拙吗？

senses.zh: 笨拙的：lacking, nimbleness, lack, skill; 不文雅的：lacking, grace, inability, graceful; 不精致的：roughly
